name: givememod
description: Say /givememod and get a Claude Code mod for the task in front of you: a plan bar, a files counter, a guard, a watcher, a pinboard. Built from tested templates, loaded live, tuned to taste; the ones you like become favorites. With the official mods docs, 29 building blocks, techniques and resources from 222 mod repositories, and a map of 3,057 public mods.
